summary: SAML assertion validation fails for Sentry-Bridge after IdP cert rotation (thumbprint mismatch)
description:
Issue summary: Users cannot sign in to the internal Sentry-Bridge UI via Okta SSO. The application rejects the SAML response with a certificate/thumbprint mismatch error.

Impact: All internal Sentry-Bridge sessions requiring SSO are blocked for engineering and oncall teams in us-east. This prevents error triage and alerts access. Estimated ~25 users affected concurrently.

Environment: prod-us-east (sentry-bridge internal proxy + idp-proxy cluster: idp-proxy-prod-01..03).

Observed behavior: Attempts to sign in redirect to Okta then return with an error page: "SAML validation failed: signature verification error (certificate thumbprint mismatch)". No new sessions created; 401 returned from idp-proxy.

Expected behavior: SAML responses should validate and sessions should be created per usual.

Steps to reproduce: 1) Visit https://sentry-bridge.internal.redwood.ai 2) Click "Sign in with SSO" 3) Authenticate in Okta 4) After redirect back, application shows SAML validation error.

Relevant runbooks and links: Confluence runbook: SSO-IdP-Metadata-Rotation (link below). Slack incident thread: #support-sso (internal).
logs: 2026-03-13T09:12:02Z idp-proxy-prod-01 ERROR SAMLValidation - signature thumbprint mismatch: expected=3F:2B:...:A4 actual=null
2026-03-13T09:12:02Z idp-proxy-prod-01 WARN MetadataFetcher - metadata last-fetched=2026-03-13T06:05:12Z (TTL 6h), fetched_cert_thumbprint=3F:2B:...:A4
2026-03-13T09:12:02Z sentry-bridge ERROR auth - SAML response rejected, upstream status 401 from idp-proxy-prod-01
steps_to_reproduce: Open an incognito browser session to eliminate cached cookies
Navigate to Sentry-Bridge internal URL and click 'Sign in with SSO'
Authenticate in Okta and observe redirect back to Sentry-Bridge where the error page is shown
investigation_notes: Checked Okta system log: IdP certificate rotation completed at 2026-03-13T08:10:00Z (thumbprint changed to 9A:7C:...:E1).
IdP metadata in Okta reflects the new cert; idp-proxy metadata fetch shows last success at 06:05UTC due to a runtime cache TTL of 6 hours.
idp-proxy configuration expects a single active thumbprint and rejects responses signed by any certificate not matching the cached value.
scim-sync is unrelated; no SCIM changes observed. No code deploys to idp-proxy at rotation time per GH deploy log.

Temporary workaround tested: hitting /admin/metadata/refresh on idp-proxy-prod-01 reloads metadata and allows a successful sign-in for that instance, but other instances still had old cache until restarted or refreshed.
mitigation: Manual mitigation applied: Forced metadata refresh on idp-proxy-prod-01..03 via admin endpoint and zero-downtime rolling restart of idp-proxy service. Verified successful sign-ins after restart on two instances.
Short-term rollback not possible because Okta cert rotation is external. We coordinated with Okta admin to confirm rotation completion and confirm no rollback planned.
resolution: Engineering fix in progress: idp-proxy patch to accept multiple active cert thumbprints during a rotation window and to proactively fetch IdP metadata on 5xx/401 thumbprint mismatch events (PR referenced above).
Rollout plan: PR -> staging smoke tests -> canary on prod small subset -> full roll. Expected deployment 2026-03-16 after additional tests.

Follow-up actions: add alerting for repeated SAML thumbprint mismatches, reduce metadata TTL to 15 minutes, add playbook step to force metadata refresh cluster-wide after certificate rotations, and update runbook with Okta rotation checklist.
